source: TSPI 3 Q3 (initial) + 25 Jul Q2 (weighted average) + FINAL RULING 5 Aug 2026 §14: Data Completeness must NOT reduce observed severity. Confidence/Completeness/Evidence Quality describe reliability and coverage only, reported separately. Coefficients remain configurable pending clinical validation.
formula: ObservedNSS = mean(Severity_i over qualifying axes) x NetworkFactor; qualifying = status in {PROVISIONALLY_ASSESSED, ASSESSED, HIGH_CONFIDENCE_ASSESSED}; severity is NEVER multiplied by confidence or completeness.

rules.completeness_never_reduces_severity: 5 Aug §14: Final Severity = Severity x Completeness is PROHIBITED. A severe measured abnormality stays severe even when the dataset is incomplete.

assessment_state_inclusion.PROVISIONALLY_ASSESSED: included only in a labelled Provisional NSS

rules.reliability_reported_separately: Every NSS output shows Observed NSS, Assessment Coverage, Overall Confidence, Biological Uncertainty, Assessment Status and Algorithm Version.
rules.no_universal_inflammatory_multiplier: An inflammation x1.3 rule must NOT be assumed a universal biological law.
